governing_conjecture: The common system underlying mathematical construction and physical processes admits a natural event-sourced control representation: states arise from admissible event histories, operations extend those histories, and observations and feedback respect their composition and retained witnesses.
operator_stimulus: Formulate and create a control-theory conjecture net for the system underlying mathematics and physics, represented as an event-sourced control system.
scope: Begin with the retained WG and declared energy-control examples; construct their common interface and physical comparison before extending the claim.

semantics.natural: Representation maps are derived from source operations, identities and composition; record context/resource choices and prove compatibility under admitted changes of presentation.
semantics.event: Typed construction/composition step with preconditions, payload, witnesses and resource effects. A physical-time interpretation is supplied by the physical realization.
semantics.state: Task-relative sufficient representation of an initial context and admissible history. The complete retained package remains available when the task quotient forgets distinctions.
semantics.depends_on: Research prerequisites rather than logical implications; a rejected candidate supplies a counterexample for successor design.
semantics.status: resolved records a scoped existing result in the cited packet; open records a remaining task. Formal four-valued outcomes remain unassigned.
semantics.assembly: Required verdicts must be constructed with compatible source, operation and resource conventions. Each assembly has an explicit acceptance test.
semantics.revision: Preserve counterexamples. A changed event vocabulary, state quotient, task class or resource policy is a versioned successor candidate.

conjectures.statement: Existing whole-package constructions retain histories, witnesses and typed composition; source relation products carry attachment data.
conjectures.scope: Specified generator policies and relation-module examples in the cited packets.
conjectures.acceptance: Reuse recovery, composition, units/associativity and source-action attachment at their stated types.
conjectures.falsifier: An alleged complete replay drops a proof payload, source action or attachment needed by a continuation.

conjectures.statement: For the declared drift/gain task, the pair (a,b) predicts all future energy observations and supports a target controller with accounted probing.
conjectures.scope: H=a+b and (a,b)->(q^2 a,q^4 b); original retained source remains separate.
conjectures.acceptance: Reuse gain composition, two-reading identification and controller updates from the probed state.
conjectures.falsifier: A permitted gain schedule distinguishes two states with identical (a,b), or the controller assumes a free reset.

conjectures.statement: Candidate: current total energy and family means suffice as control state for future gains.
conjectures.acceptance: All admitted gain continuations have identical energy observations for equal proposed states.
conjectures.falsifier: Equal current H and means yield H/4 versus H/16 under the same q=1/2 gain.
conjectures.counterexample: One-leg versus two-leg disagreement: a scalar present readout forgets a predictive distinction.

conjectures.statement: Sontag's finite context example distinguishes authority and resources through lawful continuation commands.
conjectures.scope: Observer/controller crossed with empty/available repair resource; grant and replenish distinguish contexts with equal immediate capability.
conjectures.acceptance: Reuse the one-step contextual distinction and context-indexed capability representation, retaining the source task success relation as explicit base data.
conjectures.falsifier: Immediate-capability quotient is used as a congruence for context updates despite the grant/replenish witness.

conjectures.statement: Candidate: the static Coherent Resolution coordinate decomposition determines a dynamic control plant.
conjectures.scope: Finite configuration/descriptor isomorphism and source kernel deformation in the existing audit.
conjectures.acceptance: Source-derived transition, admissible intervention and output maps with the declared parameter interpretation.
conjectures.falsifier: Static coordinates and Schur elimination supply no such transition/actuation maps; the middle-entry field also defeats boundary-only reconstruction.
conjectures.counterexample: At m=3 the (2,2)-supported field has zero characteristic boundaries and nonzero mixed curvature. Preserve the full descriptor and the missing dynamic-source map separately.

conjectures.statement: Specify an event-sourced control interface from the actual source operations of the two examples.
conjectures.scope: Initial context, state types, event preconditions/payloads, composition witnesses, observations and resource effects.
conjectures.acceptance: Give typed maps for history extension, reconstruction, observation and control; include Sontag's context updates and an explicit source task/success relation; show how supplied choices enter each map.
conjectures.falsifier: Event labels hide incompatible operation domains or erase state needed by the next event.
conjectures.next_action: Build an interface table for WG composition and family gain/probe events using their existing functions; include failure/precondition and retained-record fields.
conjectures.deliverable: Typed interface contract and two explicit event dictionaries.

conjectures.statement: The chosen history-to-state relation is a congruence for admitted continuations and observations under fixed resources.
conjectures.scope: Task and context indexed behavioural equivalence; distinguish a complete retained package from each predictive quotient.
conjectures.acceptance: If histories are identified, transport each admissible continuation with matching observation and resource effects; prove compatibility with composition and replay.
conjectures.falsifier: Two identified histories admit different next operations or produce different readouts under the same continuation.
conjectures.next_action: Test H-only and (a,b) states against the gain hostile, then test WG histories against the relation-product attachment witness.
conjectures.deliverable: Scoped sufficiency/congruence witness and explicit rejected coarse-state candidates.

conjectures.statement: Observations and feedback are well-defined operations on the event-sourced representation.
conjectures.scope: Policies depend on available observations and retained records; probing effects and resource use are included in the event sequence.
conjectures.acceptance: Specify policy input information, observation back-action model, state update and feedback composition; derive controllability/observability claims for the selected task.
conjectures.falsifier: Policy uses inaccessible state, confuses possible preparation variations with executable controls, or targets from a pre-probe state.
conjectures.next_action: Express the existing safe energy probe and target gain as a closed-loop event trace with explicit information available at each decision.
conjectures.deliverable: Executable closed-loop trace and information/resource audit.

conjectures.statement: The control representation commutes with admitted source presentation changes.
conjectures.scope: Declared WG recovery/comparison maps and task-specific state charts; source choices remain explicit.
conjectures.acceptance: Construct event/state/observer comparison squares and their composition coherence; transport policies where their observation interfaces agree.
conjectures.falsifier: A reindexing preserves terminal values but changes enabled controls or loses attachment needed for composition.
conjectures.next_action: Compare one retained WG presentation change and one energy-state chart through the typed interface, retaining witnesses in both routes.
conjectures.deliverable: Naturality squares with continuation and policy transport tests.

conjectures.statement: The bounded mathematical constructions instantiate one event-sourced control semantics.
conjectures.scope: WG composition and energy task, including their different state and witness types.
conjectures.acceptance: Assemble the two instances under the same interface with compatible event composition, reconstruction and observation semantics.
conjectures.falsifier: Each instance requires a different meaning of state identity or event composition hidden by the shared notation.
conjectures.next_action: Review and assemble the interface instances after their comparison gates close.

conjectures.statement: A specified physical process realizes the typed event/control interface with its own preparations, observations, timing and resource exchanges.
conjectures.scope: A named physical candidate and task; component dynamics and control authority specified independently.
conjectures.acceptance: Declare source-to-physical state/action/readout maps, admitted interventions, physical-time map where used, and resource/back-action accounting; supply executable comparison evidence.
conjectures.falsifier: An abstract event requires an unavailable intervention, record, clock or resource exchange in the proposed realization.
conjectures.next_action: Select a concrete candidate only when source operation/preparation/readout evidence is available; record the first missing typed ingredient and its acceptance test if unavailable.
conjectures.deliverable: Physical binding candidate with evidence, or a typed blocker and reopening condition.
conjectures.activation: If only an external authority request is executable, remove this task from the actionable frontier and keep its blocker on this node.

conjectures.statement: Mathematical and physical control realizations arise from one event/composition source and agree on its licensed continuations.
conjectures.scope: Shared initial context, event identity, resource policy and observation comparisons.
conjectures.acceptance: Exhibit both realization maps on the same source and commuting intervention/observation diagrams, including intermediate histories.
conjectures.falsifier: The realizations agree only on endpoint outputs while using incompatible events or resource policies.
conjectures.next_action: Compare a shared nontrivial composed event and an equal-readout/different-continuation pair across the two realizations.

conjectures.statement: The representation extends coherently over the intended common-system scope.
conjectures.scope: Declare generation, limits/completions and admissible feedback classes; begin from the bounded instances.
conjectures.acceptance: Supply a coverage/completion principle preserving event composition, state reconstruction and continuation sufficiency with explicit quantifiers.
conjectures.falsifier: A limit or overlapping task class admits a continuation absent from the proposed representation.
conjectures.next_action: State the exact extension claim and identify the construction/completion theorem it needs.
conjectures.deliverable: Coverage theorem or explicit restricted scope for the root.

conjectures.statement: The common system admits the natural event-sourced control representation at the declared scope.
conjectures.scope: One compatible source account and reviewed extension scope.
conjectures.acceptance: Review same-source comparison, naturality and coverage on compatible witnesses, then explicitly admit the scoped result.
conjectures.falsifier: The assembly changes the event vocabulary, identity relation or resource policy between its premises.
conjectures.next_action: Assemble and review the common-witness result after the incoming gates close.
